---
title: "volcano plot"
author: "Zhao2026"
output: volcano plot
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(openxlsx)

##protein
excel_file <- file.choose()
setwd(dirname(excel_file))

sheet_names <- getSheetNames(excel_file)

comp_df <- data.frame(
  sheet = sheet_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
comp_df$x_lab    <- paste0("Log2(", gsub(" vs ", "/", comp_df$sheet), ")")
comp_df$pdf_file <- paste0(comp_df$sheet, ".pdf")

for (i in 1:nrow(comp_df)) {

  current_sheet <- comp_df$sheet[i]
  current_xlab  <- comp_df$x_lab[i]
  current_pdf   <- comp_df$pdf_file[i]

  voldata <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = current_sheet)
  voldata <- as.data.frame(voldata)

  voldata$Ratio  <- log2(voldata$Ratio)
  voldata$pValue <- -log10(voldata$pValue)
  voldata <- voldata[order(voldata$Ratio, decreasing = TRUE), ]

  # Grouping by significance
  voldata$sig <- NA
  voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue < 1.30103) | 
                (voldata$Ratio < 0.378511623 & voldata$Ratio > -0.378511623)] <- "no"
  voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue >= 1.30103) & (voldata$Ratio >= 0.378511623)]  <- "up"
  voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue >= 1.30103) & (voldata$Ratio <= -0.378511623)] <- "down"
  voldata$sig <- factor(voldata$sig, levels = c("down", "no", "up"))

  p <- ggplot(voldata, aes(Ratio, pValue, color = sig)) +
    geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0) +
    xlim(-4, 4) +
    ylim(0, 3) +
    labs(x = current_xlab, y = "-Log10(adjusted P)") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("#08519C", "gray", "darkred")) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1.30103, linetype = 5, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.378511623, 0.378511623), linetype = 5, alpha = 0.5) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      panel.border      = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x       = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.line.y       = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.y      = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.x      = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
      axis.text         = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title        = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(b = 6, l = 6, t = 6, r = 6)),
      legend.title      = element_blank(),
      legend.text       = element_text(size = 14),
      plot.margin       = unit(c(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3), "cm")
    )

  ggsave(
    filename = current_pdf,
    plot     = p,
    device   = cairo_pdf,
    width    = 5.75,
    height   = 4.53,
    units    = "in",
    dpi      = 300
  )
}


##metabolite
excel_file <- file.choose()
setwd(dirname(excel_file))

sheet_names <- getSheetNames(excel_file)

comp_df <- data.frame(
  sheet = sheet_names,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
comp_df$x_lab    <- paste0("Log2(", gsub(" vs ", "/", comp_df$sheet), ")")
comp_df$pdf_file <- paste0(comp_df$sheet, ".pdf")

i <- 1
current_sheet <- comp_df$sheet[i]
current_xlab  <- comp_df$x_lab[i]
current_pdf   <- comp_df$pdf_file[i]

voldata <- read.xlsx(excel_file, sheet = current_sheet)
voldata <- as.data.frame(voldata)

# Grouping by significance (metabolomics VIP logic)
voldata$sig <- NA
voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue < 1.30103) | (voldata$vip <= 1)] <- "no"
voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue > 1.30103) & (voldata$vip > 1) & (voldata$Ratio > 0)] <- "up"
voldata$sig[(voldata$pValue > 1.30103) & (voldata$vip > 1) & (voldata$Ratio < 0)] <- "down"
voldata$sig <- factor(voldata$sig, levels = c("down", "no", "up"))

p <- ggplot(voldata, aes(Ratio, pValue, color = sig, size = vip)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, stroke = 0) +
  xlim(-5, 5) + ylim(0, 8) +
  labs(x = current_xlab, y = "-Log10(adjusted P)") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#08519C", "gray", "darkred")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1.30103, linetype = 5, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 5, alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    panel.border      = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x       = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.line.y       = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.title.y      = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.y      = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.x      = element_line(color = "black", size = 0.5),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(0.1, "cm"),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 14, margin = margin(b = 6, l = 6, t = 6, r = 6)),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14),
    plot.margin       = unit(c(0.3, 0.3, 0.3, 0.3), "cm")
  ) + 
  guides(size  = guide_legend(title = "vip"),
         color = guide_legend(title = "status"))

ggsave(
  filename = current_pdf,
  plot     = p,
  device   = cairo_pdf,
  width    = 5.75,
  height   = 4.53,
  units    = "in",
  dpi      = 300
)

```
